Geographies Served Programs Special School For The Intellectually Challenged District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana The organisation focus on special education and offers personalized learning programs to meet each child's unique needs. Sadhana’s services include occupational, speech, and physical therapy, aimed at enhancing motor skills and overall development. The organization fosters a supportive and inclusive environment, empowering children to reach their full potential. As one of the leading special education centers in the region, Sadhana continues to be a vital resource for families in need of specialized care and education. Sadhana’s Home for Senior Citizens District Hyderabad State Telangana District Hyderabad States Telangana Sadhana’s Home for Senior Citizens, provides a caring and supportive environment for elderly individuals whose children have migrated for education or careers. With the rising phenomenon of “empty nests” in India, Sadhana offers a safe and hygienic space for elderly residents, focusing on their well-being. Currently housing 25 senior citizens, the home provides a homely atmosphere combined with professional medical care, ensuring a dignified and comfortable life for its residents. The initiative aims to address the growing need for quality care and support for vulnerable senior citizens. Our theory of change is based on the following key assumptions: 1.Providing specialized education and support can improve the quality of life for mentally challenged individuals. 2.Mentally challenged individuals can learn and develop new skills with the right support and resources. 3.Enabling mentally challenged individuals to live independently and participate in their communities can increase their self-esteem and sense of belonging. To achieve our mission, Sadhana operates on the following theory of change: Inputs: Expert staff with specialized training in working with mentally challenged individuals Access to specialized educational resources and equipment Supportive environment and facilities conducive to learning and development Activities: Providing specialized educational programs designed to meet the unique needs of mentally challenged individuals Providing individualized support to address specific challenges and foster skill development Providing opportunities for community participation and integration Providing support and resources to help individuals live independently Outputs: Improved academic and life skills for mentally challenged individuals Increased self-esteem and sense of belonging Improved social and emotional well-being Outcomes: Increased independence and ability to live fulfilling lives Improved integration and participation in the community Reduced social isolation and stigma associated with mental challenges Impact: Mentally challenged individuals are empowered to lead fulfilling lives and contribute to their communities. In summary, Sadhana Institute for mentally challenged individuals aims to provide a supportive and empowering environment that enables individuals to reach their full potential and live fulfilling lives. We believe that by investing in specialized education and support, we can make a positive impact on the lives of our students and their communities --> Milestones & Track Record Established in the year 1996 Started rural center for intellectually challenged at Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District in the year 1999 with permanent building State Bank of India Donated school bus in the year 2000 Recognized by State and central government in the year 2001 H.P.CL. constructed kitchen cum dining hall at our Rural center Tekulasomaram Village Valigonda Manadal ,Yadadri Bhuvanagiri in the year 2002 In 2006 we have purchased the land from Government and YSR foundation helped us in purchasing the land In 2007 State bank of Hyderabad donated school van In 2007 Construction was started In June 2009 Construction of ground and First floor Completed and we have shifted the school from Habsiguda to Nacharam In 2012 We have constructed 2nd floor with the help of Genpact in the same year we have started the Home for senior Citizens and Elderly persons with Intellectual disability.
